rule: On one note hit: read input with its timestamp and judge on the note time minus song position minus input latency; dispatch a cancellable event; play the strum confirm and remove the note; play the pooled splash (random variant, fps jitter); play the hold cover if any; restore the player voice stem; apply score and show the rating popup (rise, then fade one beat later); play the character pose by direction, and the spectator reacts to combo. On a miss: score penalty, health penalty, mute the player voice stem, play one random miss sound from a pool, and play the miss pose (double sing hold). Haptics: each confirmed lane adds a quarter of max amplitude, times 2.5, clamped. Camera bump is music-synced (every 4 beats), not hit-driven. No hit shake, flash, hit-stop or hit sound exists in play/.
